target.title: Add predictive pace warnings
target.body:
## Summary
- add a default-off Predictive pace warnings toggle in Notifications
- warn for Codex and Claude session/weekly windows when existing pace projections show quota may run out before reset
- keep warning episodes scoped in memory by provider, account, window, and reset identity, re-arming only after healthy observations
- localize the predictive pace warning preference and notification copy across app catalogs, preserving provider-first notification titles
- use Claude OAuth owner evidence as a non-rendered discriminator for normal and selected-account no-email OAuth snapshots without exposing account data

Closes #1299

## Runtime proof
Current-head redacted local app run from `f34ca8a1d9b3aaee6992e73c6e8324d11313cb19`, July 7 2026:
- staged a temporary `com.steipete.codexbar.debug` app bundle from the current SwiftPM debug binary at `.build/arm64-apple-macosx/debug/CodexBar`
- launched with disposable `HOME`, `CFFIXED_USER_HOME`, `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, `CODEXBAR_CONFIG`, and `CODEX_CLI_PATH`; no real account, token, cookie, or Keychain data was used
- config enabled only Codex CLI source with OpenAI cookies off; UserDefaults enabled predictive pace warnings, hid personal info, disabled keychain access, and turned sound/overlay off
- synthetic Codex app-server returned a 5h window at 80% used/reset in 2h and a weekly window at 90% used/reset in 2d, so both windows predict run-out before reset
- the disposable debug bundle has no macOS notification authorization, so the run stops at the expected `AppNotifications` authorization gate after both warning IDs are enqueued

```text
2026-07-07 18:45:11.236 I CodexBar[...] [com.steipete.codexbar:app] CodexBar starting (build=1960 built=2026-07-07T08:45:08Z git=f34ca8a version=0.5.4)
2026-07-07 18:45:11.359 I CodexBar[...] [com.steipete.codexbar:providers] Provider enablement at startup (enabled=codex ... claude=0 ... codex=1 ...)
2026-07-07 18:45:11.359 I CodexBar[...] [com.steipete.codexbar:providers] Provider mode snapshot (... codexCookieSource=off codexUsageSource=auto ... openAIWebAccess=0 ...)
2026-07-07 18:45:11.568 Db CodexBar[...] [com.steipete.codexbar:codex-rpc] Codex RPC started (binary=<synthetic codex-stub>)
2026-07-07 18:45:12.165 I CodexBar[...] [com.steipete.codexbar:sessionQuotaNotifications] enqueuing (prefix=predictive-pace-warning-codex-session)
2026-07-07 18:45:12.284 I CodexBar[...] [com.steipete.codexbar:sessionQuotaNotifications] enqueuing (prefix=predictive-pace-warning-codex-weekly)
2026-07-07 18:45:12.292 Db CodexBar[...] [com.steipete.codexbar:notifications] not authorized; skipping post (prefix=predictive-pace-warning-codex-session)
2026-07-07 18:45:12.292 Db CodexBar[...] [com.steipete.codexbar:notifications] not authorized; skipping post (prefix=predictive-pace-warning-codex-weekly)
2026-07-07 18:45:12.431 Db CodexBar[...] [com.steipete.codexbar:openai-web] OpenAI web refresh gate (accessEnabled=0 allowed=0 batterySaverEnabled=0 force=0 interaction=background phase=startup)
```

Current-head selected Claude OAuth terminal proof from `f34ca8a1d9b3aaee6992e73c6e8324d11313cb19`, July 7 2026:
- `swift test --filter PredictivePaceWarningTests` exercises the predictive warning state machine, Codex and Claude posting paths, privacy hiding, default-off persistence, no-email Claude OAuth owner discrimination, and the selected Claude OAuth token-account owner discriminator path added after the older runtime proof

```text
f34ca8a1d9b3aaee6992e73c6e8324d11313cb19
$ swift test --filter PredictivePaceWarningTests
◇ Suite PredictivePaceWarningTests started.
◇ Test "selected Claude OAuth token account uses owner discriminator when email is missing" started.
✔ Test "store isolates no-email Claude OAuth risk episodes by owner discriminator" passed after 0.354 seconds.
✔ Test "store posts for Codex session and weekly risk" passed after 0.354 seconds.
✔ Test "selected Claude OAuth token account uses owner discriminator when email is missing" passed after 0.356 seconds.
✔ Suite PredictivePaceWarningTests passed after 0.356 seconds.
✔ Test run with 11 tests in 1 suite passed after 0.356 seconds.
```

## Validation
- `swift test --filter PredictivePaceWarningTests` (11/11)
- `node Scripts/check-app-locales.mjs --test && node Scripts/check-app-locales.mjs`
- `make check`
- `make test` (blocked by local managed-account state in `TokenAccountEnvironmentPrecedenceTests/codex CLI ignores relative profile homes`; the same failure reproduces on `origin/main` at `46edb38`)
